related.title: FANUC LR Mate 小型工業手臂
related.titleEn: FANUC LR Mate compact industrial arm
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付質心圖、彎矩表與內移夾具的空間檢核。；教學靜態門檻 80 N·m 下兩案都通過；設計交付仍需另列動態尚未驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a center-of-mass diagram, moment table and access check for the inward fixture.; Both cases pass the teaching 80 N·m static limit; the report must still identify unverified dynamics.
related.difference: 分離重複性、視覺誤差與定位偏差，建立小件放置誤差預算。
related.differenceEn: Separate repeatability, vision error and bias in a small-part placement budget.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 同方向重力彎矩相加 M=Σmigr，質量與偏置共同決定負荷。；教學工件 20 kg 偏置 0.35 m，工具 5 kg 偏置 0.10 m。；M=(20×0.35+5×0.10)×9.81=73.575 N·m。
獨立零均值誤差可用平方和開根號；系統偏差需另列而不能隱藏在 RSS。；教學標準差為手臂 0.03 mm、視覺 0.04 mm；另有 0.12 mm 校準偏差。；σ=sqrt(0.03²+0.04²)=0.05 mm；偏差仍為 0.12 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Aligned gravity moments add as M=Σmigr; both mass and offset determine loading.; Teaching workpiece: 20 kg at 0.35 m; tool: 5 kg at 0.10 m.; M=(20×0.35+5×0.10)×9.81=73.575 N·m.

Independent zero-mean errors combine by RSS; systematic bias must remain separate.; Teaching standard deviations: robot 0.03 mm and vision 0.04 mm; calibration bias is separately 0.12 mm.; σ=sqrt(0.03²+0.04²)=0.05 mm; the bias remains 0.12 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: AutoStore 立體倉儲系統
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付質心圖、彎矩表與內移夾具的空間檢核。；教學靜態門檻 80 N·m 下兩案都通過；設計交付仍需另列動態尚未驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a center-of-mass diagram, moment table and access check for the inward fixture.; Both cases pass the teaching 80 N·m static limit; the report must still identify unverified dynamics.
related.difference: 量化深層挖箱對延遲的影響，理解平均延遲不能代表尾端。
related.differenceEn: Quantify digging delay and distinguish average from tail latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 同方向重力彎矩相加 M=Σmigr，質量與偏置共同決定負荷。；教學工件 20 kg 偏置 0.35 m，工具 5 kg 偏置 0.10 m。；M=(20×0.35+5×0.10)×9.81=73.575 N·m。
簡化檢索時間 T=(d−1)tr+tt+tp，其中 d 為目標深度。；教學 d=5、每上層挪箱 4 s、運送 12 s、呈現 8 s。；T=(5−1)×4+12+8=36 s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Aligned gravity moments add as M=Σmigr; both mass and offset determine loading.; Teaching workpiece: 20 kg at 0.35 m; tool: 5 kg at 0.10 m.; M=(20×0.35+5×0.10)×9.81=73.575 N·m.
Simplified retrieval time T=(d−1)tr+tt+tp, where d is target depth.; Teaching d=5, relocation 4 s, transport 12 s and presentation 8 s.; T=(5−1)×4+12+8=36 s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
